description: Heart and blood vessel conditions treated with medicines, angiography, angioplasty, stents and pacemakers
route_here_when: Heart condition managed with medicines, tests or catheter procedures: angina, heart attack care, arrhythmia, heart failure, high blood pressure, angioplasty, stents, pacemaker
not_here: A planned heart or chest operation (bypass, valve replacement) → Cardiothoracic Surgery; a child's heart defect → Pediatric Cardiology; breathlessness from lung disease → Pulmonology

description: Surgery on the heart, lungs, chest and major blood vessels: bypass (CABG), valve repair or replacement, open heart surgery, aortic surgery
route_here_when: A heart, lung, chest or aortic operation is planned or recommended: bypass (CABG), valve repair or replacement, open-heart surgery, aortic aneurysm surgery
not_here: Medicines, angiography or stents only → Cardiology; heart surgery for a child's congenital defect → Pediatric Cardiology

description: Heart conditions in babies and children, including congenital heart defects
route_here_when: A baby or child with a heart problem, usually present from birth: hole in the heart (VSD/ASD), tetralogy of Fallot, blue baby
not_here: Heart disease in an adult → Cardiology

description: Cancer diagnosis and treatment: chemotherapy, radiotherapy, immunotherapy and cancer surgery
route_here_when: Confirmed or suspected cancer and its treatment: chemotherapy, radiotherapy, cancer surgery
not_here: Blood cancers (leukaemia, lymphoma, myeloma) and bone marrow transplant → Hematology & Bone Marrow Transplant; brain tumour surgery → Neurosurgery

description: Blood disorders and bone marrow transplant: leukaemia, lymphoma, myeloma, thalassemia, anaemia, bleeding disorders
route_here_when: Blood disorders and blood cancers: anaemia, thalassaemia, sickle cell, haemophilia, leukaemia, lymphoma, myeloma; bone marrow or stem cell transplant
not_here: Kidney, liver, heart or lung transplant → Organ Transplant; solid tumours → Oncology

description: Bones, joints, spine and sports injuries: fractures, joint replacement, arthritis, back pain
route_here_when: Bones, joints, ligaments and spine: fractures, arthritis, joint replacement, sports injuries, slipped disc, back and neck problems
not_here: Brain or spinal cord surgery for tumours or nerve compression → Neurosurgery; nerve disease without an injury → Neurology

description: Brain, spinal cord and nerve conditions treated without surgery: stroke, epilepsy, headache, migraine, Parkinson's, neuropathy
route_here_when: Brain and nerve conditions treated without surgery: stroke, epilepsy, headache, migraine, Parkinson's disease, dementia, neuropathy, multiple sclerosis
not_here: Brain tumour, aneurysm or spine surgery → Neurosurgery; a problem of the eye itself → Ophthalmology

description: Surgery of the brain, spine and nerves: brain tumours, aneurysms, spinal cord compression, hydrocephalus
route_here_when: Surgery on the brain, spinal cord or nerves: brain tumour, aneurysm, hydrocephalus, spinal cord compression, head injury surgery
not_here: Stroke, epilepsy or headaches treated without surgery → Neurology

description: Stomach, intestines, liver, pancreas and gallbladder: acidity, ulcers, IBD, hepatitis, endoscopy
route_here_when: Stomach, intestines, liver, pancreas and gallbladder: acidity, ulcers, liver disease, jaundice, inflammatory bowel disease, endoscopy, colonoscopy
not_here: Liver transplant → Organ Transplant; cancer of a digestive organ → Oncology

description: Kidney disease treated medically: chronic kidney disease, dialysis, protein in urine
route_here_when: Kidney disease treated with medicines or dialysis: chronic kidney disease, kidney failure, protein in urine
not_here: Kidney or ureter stones, prostate and bladder problems → Urology; kidney transplant → Organ Transplant

description: Urinary tract and male reproductive organs: kidney stones, prostate, bladder problems
route_here_when: Urinary tract and male reproductive organs: kidney and ureter stones, prostate, bladder, urine infection, incontinence
not_here: Kidney failure or dialysis → Nephrology; male infertility treatment → Reproductive Medicine

description: Kidney, liver, heart and other organ transplants, including living donor transplants
route_here_when: Solid-organ transplant: kidney, liver, heart or lung, including living donor transplants
not_here: Bone marrow or stem cell transplant → Hematology & Bone Marrow Transplant; hair transplant → Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery

description: Pregnancy, childbirth and women's reproductive health: fibroids, ovarian cysts, menstrual problems, hysterectomy
route_here_when: Pregnancy, childbirth and women's reproductive organs: periods, fibroids, ovarian cysts, menopause, hysterectomy
not_here: Infertility or IVF → Reproductive Medicine; cancer of the breast, uterus or ovary → Oncology

description: Infertility treatment: IVF, ICSI, IUI, egg freezing, male infertility
route_here_when: Trouble conceiving and fertility treatment: IVF, IUI, ICSI, egg freezing, male or female infertility
not_here: Pregnancy care and delivery → Obstetrics & Gynaecology

description: Medical care for babies, children and adolescents, including newborn care and development
route_here_when: Children's general health and childhood illnesses, newborn and premature baby care
not_here: A child whose problem has its own speciality is routed by the problem: heart defect → Pediatric Cardiology, cleft lip → Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery, liver transplant → Organ Transplant

description: Hormone and metabolic conditions: diabetes, thyroid, PCOS, obesity, growth and adrenal problems
route_here_when: Hormone and gland conditions: diabetes, thyroid, PCOS, pituitary and adrenal disorders
not_here: Weight-loss surgery → Bariatric Surgery; diabetic damage to the eyes or kidneys → Ophthalmology or Nephrology

description: Lung and breathing conditions: asthma, COPD, TB, pneumonia, sleep apnoea
route_here_when: Lungs and breathing: asthma, COPD, tuberculosis, pneumonia, persistent cough, sleep apnoea
not_here: Chest pain with heart symptoms → Cardiology; a patient on a ventilator or in intensive care → Critical Care

description: Reconstruction after burns, injury, cancer or birth defects, and cosmetic surgery
route_here_when: Reconstruction and repair: burn scars, cleft lip and palate, skin grafts, cosmetic surgery, hair transplant
not_here: A fresh burn injury → Emergency Medicine

description: Weight-loss surgery for severe obesity: gastric sleeve, gastric bypass, gastric balloon
route_here_when: Severe obesity where weight-loss surgery is considered: gastric sleeve, gastric bypass, gastric balloon
not_here: Hormonal causes of weight gain → Endocrinology

description: Immediate care for accidents, injuries, poisoning and sudden life-threatening problems
route_here_when: Accidents, injuries, poisoning, severe allergic reactions and other problems needing care now
not_here: A planned or long-standing problem → the speciality that treats it

description: Intensive care (ICU) for critically ill patients: ventilator support, sepsis, multi-organ failure
route_here_when: A critically ill patient who needs intensive care: ICU, ventilator, sepsis, multi-organ failure
not_here: Urgent but stable problems → Emergency Medicine

description: Eye conditions: cataract, glaucoma, retina problems, vision loss, eye infections
route_here_when: Eyes and vision: cataract, glaucoma, retina, squint, eye infections, LASIK
not_here: Vision loss caused by a brain or nerve condition → Neurology

description: Ear, nose and throat: hearing loss, sinus, tonsils, voice problems, cochlear implants
route_here_when: Ear, nose, throat and voice: hearing loss, sinusitis, tonsils, hoarse voice, cochlear implant
not_here: Lung or breathing disease → Pulmonology; cancer of the mouth or throat → Oncology

description: Skin, hair and nail conditions: psoriasis, eczema, acne, vitiligo, fungal infections
route_here_when: Skin, hair and nails: rashes, eczema, psoriasis, acne, fungal infections, hair loss
not_here: Burn scars or skin reconstruction → Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery

description: Mental health: depression, anxiety, panic attacks, addiction, sleep and behaviour problems
route_here_when: Mental health: depression, anxiety, panic, bipolar disorder, schizophrenia, addiction, sleep problems
not_here: Memory loss from dementia → Neurology

description: First point of care for common illness, fevers, infections and general check-ups when no specialty is clear
route_here_when: General or unclear illness and infections: fever, malaria, dengue, typhoid, fatigue, health check-ups
not_here: A message that names a specific condition or procedure → that speciality
